```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
root = Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root == root.parent: raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root = root.parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('maps', root/'context/dades/cartografia_figures.py')
maps = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(maps)
features, result = maps.load(root)
rows = [f['properties'] for f in features if 'moran_z' in f['properties']]
z = np.array([r['moran_z'] for r in rows]); lag = np.array([r['moran_lag'] for r in rows])
slope = z @ lag / (z @ z)
assert np.isclose(slope, result['moran']['I']) and len(rows) == 150
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.7, 5.5), layout='constrained')
ax = axes[0]
ax.scatter(z, lag, s=24, color='#326b94', alpha=.65)
x = np.array([z.min()-.2, z.max()+.2]); ax.plot(x, slope*x, color='#bd3644', lw=2)
ax.axhline(0, color='#87939e', lw=.8); ax.axvline(0, color='#87939e', lw=.8)
ax.set(title='A · Diagrama de Moran', xlabel='Valor estandarditzat de log(1 + q)',
       ylabel='Mitjana estandarditzada dels veïns')
ax.text(.03, .97, 'n = 150\nI = 0,144\npseudo-p = 0,0024', transform=ax.transAxes,
        va='top', bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.9})
palette = {'HH':'#c73942','LH':'#90b9d6','LL':'#27608f','HL':'#edb193'}
def colour(p):
    if 'moran_z' not in p: return '#666f78'
    return palette[p['moran_quadrant']] if p['moran_fdr'] else '#e1e4e8'
maps.draw(axes[1], features, colour, 'B · Moran local\ndesprés de BH-FDR')
fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor='#c73942', label='HH: 1 secció'),
                    Patch(facecolor='#e1e4e8', label='No destacada: 149'),
                    Patch(facecolor='#666f78', label='No calculable: 1')],
           loc='outside lower center', ncol=3, frameon=False, fontsize=14)
maps.save(fig, root, 'moran-tarragones')
```
